neighbours.label: the part-of-day word (night, evening, morning) right after a weekday name ('Saturday night')
fire: We were stuck at home on a Tuesday night with nothing to do.
Bands play at the pub every Thursday night in summer.
Bored on a Wednesday evening, I started painting.
The show aired each Sunday night for nine years.
The council meets on Monday evening at the town hall.
Traffic was awful on Friday morning near the bridge.
Dinner is served on Saturday night at eight.
My flight leaves early on Sunday morning from Leeds.
quiet: We were stuck at home on a Tuesday with nothing to do.
Bands play at the pub every week in summer.
Bored at home, I started painting in the garage.
The show aired each week for nine years.
The council meets on Monday at the town hall.
Traffic was awful on Friday near the bridge.
Dinner is served on Saturday at eight.
My flight leaves early on Sunday from Leeds.

short: part of day after a weekday
notes: The card flags the pole broad (1.2%), and its max is small (2.27). 'Friday night', 'Sunday evening', 'Monday morning' fire; 'at night', 'Last night' and the weekday alone stay low. 'good night' also fires, as do ' reaction' and the 'v' in Negev, so this is likely partial.
